title: Insectarium Spellforge Garden
description: A surreal painting features a giant stylized human eye with pink eyebrow and blue iris at the top, with a colorful bird, bees, and a large mushroom floating nearby. Below is an open green window-like structure labeled 'INSECTARIUM SPELLFORGE GARDEN DIVISION' containing a female character with wild magenta hair in a red outfit holding a spray can emitting orange mist, surrounded by vibrant mushrooms, vines, and insects.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic artwork showing a massive stylized human eye with pink eyebrow and vibrant blue iris at the top of the composition. A colorful bird and flying insects hover near the eye. Below is an open green cabinet or window structure labeled INSECTARIUM SPELLFORGE GARDEN DIVISION. Inside stands a woman with wild flowing magenta hair wearing a red crop top and shorts with white boots, holding a spray can that emits orange mist. The base is filled with glowing mushrooms in pink, blue, and orange, green vines, and various insects against a dark background.
